decisions.reason: The net price display plugin remains closely tied to the firm's existing shop-extension and customization knowledge, so with in-house R&D and a growing market the firm would usually keep and incrementally refine it rather than withdraw it.

The ERP system interface plugin builds directly on the firm's strongest integration capabilities and supports its multichannel direction, making it the least likely of these products to be taken off the market.

After earlier rationalization of similar tracking plugins, the remaining price comparison tracking plugin is likely the version the firm learned how to support best, so it is kept, though changing comparison-platform requirements still create some withdrawal risk.

The net price reporting plugin fits the firm's analytics and optimization competences and can be improved through existing client knowledge and own development, so management would tend to retain it unless its niche demand fades.
